response.sql: WITH tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(pulsepersec) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS overall_avg FROM signals), k1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse FROM tel t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_pulse > o.overall_avg), second AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS second_avg FROM k1), fin AS (SELECT k.telescref, k.avg_pulse FROM k1 k CROSS JOIN second s WHERE k.avg_pulse > s.second_avg) SELECT AVG(f.avg_pulse) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(f.avg_pulse - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_overall, AVG(f.avg_pulse - s.second_avg) AS mean_excess_over_second FROM fin f CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN second s

assumptions.assumption: The 'overall average pulse rate' is the pooled average of pulsepersec over all signal rows with non-null values, not the mean of the per-telescope averages.
Telescopes whose pulsepersec values are all NULL have no average and are excluded.
The 'second average' is the mean of the kept telescopes' averages from the first filter, and the final filter is strictly greater than it.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-telescope averages, not the pooled row-level average.
